name: Omamail
author: Jason Lee <huacnlee@gmail.com>
description: Email client for Omarchy: read, triage, and reply to Gmail and any IMAP mailbox in a native window. Fastmail, iCloud, Outlook, Zoho, or your own server.

barWidget.description: Unread mail count in the bar; the inbox itself opens as its own window. Works with Gmail and any IMAP mail server.

schema.label: Check for mail every (seconds)
schema.description: How often the unread count is refreshed while the panel is closed.

schema.label: Default search
schema.description: Applies to the inbox only. Gmail accounts take any Gmail search operator, for example `in:inbox -category:promotions`; IMAP accounts take IMAP SEARCH criteria.

schema.label: Notify on new mail
schema.description: Sends a desktop notification when a new unread message arrives in the inbox.

schema.label: Sign-in callback port
schema.description: Loopback port used once during Google sign-in. IMAP accounts never use it. Change it only if something else already listens there.

schema.label: Clicking the bar icon opens
schema.description: The full window, or a small card with the most recent unread mail.
